messages:
maya: heads-up: partner proxy calls are being billed to the proxy org not the partner project. console shows partner project though.
own: saw this in integration test. token exchange drops origin claim so routing attributes to proxy.
lee: is the exchange flow removing `origin` claim or normalizing `sub`?
maya: exchange mints a proxy-scoped token and doesn't copy original `org/project` claims. downstream services rely on claims for quota/billing.
sam: quick mitigation: have proxy emit an `x-origin-id` header we can read in telemetry only. not trusted for billing but helps surface issues.
kevin: cannot use raw headers for billing — forgery risk. two safe options: signed-origin claim or keep exchange-id mapping server-side and lookup during routing.
own: mapping is lower friction for partners. exchange records exchange_id->origin when minting; routing does a cache lookup.
lee: quota enforcement requires the project at request time. cache lookup must be sub-ms or we do "enforce on proxy identity" while tracking a "would-have" metric.
maya: rollout proposal: phase A telemetry only (2w, 1% sample); phase B console reconciliation view + inferred-origin column; phase C canary mapping for partner P-99 in us-west-2 (10% sampling, 72h); phase D optional signed-origin pilot.
kevin: I'll add metrics: `auth.exchange.lookup_req`, `auth.exchange.lookup_hit`, `auth.exchange.lookup_miss`, `auth.exchange.lookup_latency_ms`, `auth.reconcile.delta_pct`. will make a Grafana board.
sam: canary playbook: partner=P-99, region=us-west-2, sample=10%, alert if delta>3% or miss>2% for 15m. rollback if p95 latency increases >50ms.
own: implementing a memcache LRU + redis fallback TTL=5m. will bench p50/p99.
lee: console UX: toggle "Show inferred origin (exchange-id)" and add a help flyout "Why billed org may differ" to reduce support tickets.
maya: action items: owen prototype cache + flag, kevin telemetry + dash, sam canary doc, lee console mock, maya rollout note to partner success.
auth-bot: deploy started: svc-auth-exchange v3.2.0 -> canary us-west-2 (1/4).
maya: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
